XENO.IO

Born a baby alien on a hostile world. Eat. Grow. Hunt — or be hunted. Survive the Extinction Event.
Planet:
Free-for-All: everyone against everyone until the Extinction Event ends. Open World: one huge map where all eight worlds meet, no timer, with migrations, meteor showers, blood moons and other world events.
Move: WASD / arrows / mouse, or drag anywhere on touch screens. Skill: Space or the round button. Ultimate (apex aliens): Q or the gold button. Bigger creatures eat smaller ones, so pick your fights.

Alien Lab

Story: The Last Hatchling

Your egg fell from a dying mothership. Seven worlds stand between you and the truth of what wiped out your kind. Every chapter ends in an Extinction Event.
